text: Olga's daughter has her driving test on 14 May. Third attempt, so Olga is more nervous than the daughter is.

Kevin and Mei are celebrating ten years married sometime next week. He wants to book somewhere by the sea but hasn't decided where. I suggested that hotel in Whitby we stayed at. He also let slip that Mei has been eyeing up a silver bracelet from the shop on the high street, so I've told him to get a move on.
Text Rory good luck on the morning of his audition. It's the 3rd of June at the conservatoire.
Mustafa's brother Farid got engaged over the weekend! The wedding will probably be over the summer next year.
Ines said her son starts his A-levels in early March with the mocks. She's worried he isn't revising at all.
Bumped into Barbara outside the chemist. Her husband Lars is having his knee done at the end of the month, so she's dreading the stairs.
Must send a card to Darius and Laila for their anniversary on 22/06.
Thabo passed his theory test! Practical is booked for 9 July.
Chen mentioned that her mum is turning seventy on 2nd of August and the whole family is flying in from Singapore. She's in charge of the cake, poor thing.
Archie's wedding is off. He and Ciara split up a couple of weeks ago and he's staying at his brother's for now. Should check in on him sometime next week.
Javier's little girl has her grade 3 piano exam on 11 May. He says she practises every evening without being asked.
Need to buy a new suit before Wiremu's wedding on 19th of September.
Mia got her results back and she's through to the second round of auditions for the youth orchestra. Next round is in early March.
Alejandro is a primary school teacher in Leeds. Loves fell running and has a rescue greyhound called Pepper.
Remind me to ask Andile how his sister's graduation went. It was on 30 June, I think.
Lindiwe and Isaac are expecting their first in early December. She's had awful morning sickness but is feeling better now.
Anil's dad has a cardiology appointment on 17/10. Anil is driving up from Bristol the night before to take him.
Car MOT due end of the month. Book it in before the 28th.

Kaito told me his wife's citizenship test is on 5 November. She's been studying every night with flashcards on the fridge, and their kids keep quizzing her over breakfast. If she passes, the ceremony would be sometime early in the new year, and they want to have a small party afterwards. Kaito wants it to be a surprise, so mum's the word.

Marcus asked if I'd be his best man! The wedding is 14th of May next year in Cork. Stag do is pencilled in for sometime in early April, probably Edinburgh or Dublin. His fiancée Ciara wants it nowhere near the wedding date, which is fair. I need to start on the speech over the summer and get everyone's deposits in by the end of January.
Emil is retaking his Year 12 maths exam in late June. His mum, Mrs Banerjee, says he's barely sleeping.
Antoine Moreau, the new guy in accounts, goes by Toni. Vegetarian, supports Lyon, and has two teenage boys.
Don't forget Jada's anniversary dinner with her partner Ali is on 8 March. I offered to babysit their kids that evening.
Lunch with Yosef. His eldest just passed her driving test first time, and his younger one starts uni in Glasgow over the summer.
Call Olga next week to see how her daughter got on.
Farid's mum has her cataract surgery on the 3rd of December. Farid will be off work for a week looking after her.
Laila hinted that Darius would love a new record player for their anniversary. Their old one finally broke.
Ciara's brother Rory is doing his bar exams in early February. She says he's convinced he'll fail, even though he never has failed anything.
Gym at 7. Then pick up dry cleaning and drop the parcel off at the post office.
Mei's parents celebrate their ruby anniversary on 12/09. Mei and Kevin are throwing them a surprise party at the golf club. I'm doing the playlist.
Lars Brennan rang about the reunion. He's moved to Aarhus with his partner and their two cats. Wants to meet up when he's back over Christmas.
Ask Thabo how his practical went. It was yesterday afternoon.
Isaac's mum had a fall last week and broke her wrist. She's staying with them until the cast comes off, sometime mid-November.

Ines Bianchi just got engaged to her long-term girlfriend, Olga. They want a small ceremony sometime next spring, nothing too fancy, probably just family and a long lunch somewhere in Tuscany where Ines's grandparents live. Ines's mum is already trying to take over the planning, which is going down about as well as you'd expect.
I should send Mustafa the photos from Farid's engagement party.
Barbara said her granddaughter has an audition for the Royal Ballet School on 21 January. Barbara's knitting her a lucky cardigan.
Anil is a paramedic and does nights most weeks. Mentioned he hates crowds and loud restaurants, so keep that in mind for his birthday.
Kevin's brother Ali is taking his driving test again on the 6th of June. Kevin is lending him the car for lessons.

Mia's results day is 15 August. She needs an A in chemistry for her place at Edinburgh. She was really anxious when we spoke and kept changing the subject. Her mum says she's been up until two most nights, and her older brother Archie, who went through clearing himself, has offered to help if it goes wrong. Text her that morning.

Darius and Laila's twentieth anniversary party is on 1st of November at the village hall. Bring a dish. Laila also said Darius has been quietly taking guitar lessons and might play something, so don't mention it to him.

Rang Uncle Javier. Aunt Barbara is home from hospital after the bypass and recovering well, though she's not allowed to drive for six weeks. He sounded exhausted and admitted he hasn't slept properly since it happened. Their son Isaac is coming down from Newcastle at the end of the month to give him a break. I should pop over one evening next week with a lasagne.
Need to get Wiremu and his fiancée something off their wedding list before the end of the month.
Chen's son has his first swimming gala on 18/11. Chen's taking the afternoon off work for it.
Mustafa has a new puppy called Biscuit. Already chewed through two pairs of trainers.
Antoine's daughter was supposed to sit her grade 5 violin exam on 2 December but it's been cancelled because the examiner is ill. They're waiting for a new date sometime in January.
Remember to wish Emil luck before his resit. Ring him the night before.
Coffee with Lindiwe. Her younger sister Jada passed her nursing exams and starts at St Thomas' in early March. Lindiwe is so proud.
Jada said her dad retires at the end of the month after thirty years on the buses. There's a do at the depot on the 30th, and I'm invited.
Yosef and his wife are renewing their vows on 7th of July for their twenty-fifth. I'm doing the flowers.
Kaito mentioned his partner's dance audition for the West End show is sometime next week. He's not allowed to say which show.
Archie's grandad, who everyone calls Pops, turns ninety on 10 March. Archie wants to put together a photo book and asked if I could scan some old pictures.
Phone Andile on Friday to check how his mum is doing after the scan.

Isaac Wright from the running club is training for his first marathon in early April. He's struggling with a calf injury and might have to defer. Physio appointment is on the 4th of November, and he'll decide after that. He also mentioned his wife Lindiwe has her driving test sometime next week, so it's a busy household. Ask him how both went.
Took the boys to football, then sorted the garden. Nothing else today.

Ciara has her solicitor exams on 14/05 and 16/05, and the results come out over the summer. She sounded fairly calm about it all, honestly. Her boyfriend Marcus is cooking for her the whole week so she can focus. I should drop round a care package the weekend before.
Olga and her husband are celebrating their engagement anniversary on the 3rd of June. They met at a ceilidh, of all places.
Alejandro failed his driving test this morning. Second time. He was gutted. Should take him out for a pint at the weekend.
Laila Gupta, Darius's sister, has just started a PhD in marine biology at Plymouth. Loves diving and keeps an axolotl.
Lars's son had his school play last night and Lars filmed the whole thing. Must remember to ask to see the video.

Mei mentioned her mum is having a hip replacement sometime early next year, and her dad isn't coping well with the idea. Mei is thinking of moving back home for a few weeks to help out. Need to check in with her before Christmas and maybe offer to look after her cat, Mochi, while she's away.
